feature_table.name: log_income
feature_table.definition: Natural log of (1 + annual income): tames the right-skewed income distribution.

feature_table.name: loan_to_income
feature_table.definition: How many years of income the loan equals.

feature_table.name: emi_estimate
feature_table.definition: Monthly instalment if the loan were charged the ASSUMED rate (14% p.a.).

feature_table.name: emi_to_income
feature_table.definition: Share of monthly income the NEW loan instalment would take.

feature_table.name: debt_service_ratio
feature_table.definition: Share of monthly income going to ALL debt payments after this loan.

feature_table.name: income_missing
feature_table.definition: 1 if the applicant did not report annual income (missingness can itself be informative).

feature_table.name: bureau_score_missing
feature_table.definition: 1 if there is no bureau score (thin-file applicant).

feature_table.name: credit_history_bucket
feature_table.definition: Bucket of credit_history_years: thin / young / established / long.

feature_table.name: city_tier
feature_table.definition: Coarse city class (tier1/2/3) instead of the fine-grained city (proxy-risk control).

feature_table.name: debt_to_income_ratio
feature_table.definition: Monthly debt payments divided by monthly income.
